  • enable -- [in] True for enable, false for disable.

void ppt_set_auto_ack(uint8_t entry, bool enable)

Set the feature of hardware auto ack the transmitted packet.

When auto ack is enabled, the read pointer of the TX FIFO will automatically add one after the packet is sent. It means the transmitted packet is discarded automatically.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • enable -- [in] True for enable, false for disable.

uint8_t ppt_trigger_fw_ack_lock(uint8_t entry, bool lock)

Firmware ack the transmitted packet once with lock flag.

The read pointer of the TX FIFO will add one which means the transmitted packet is discarded.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • lock -- [in] True for lock the header and the TX FIFO.

Returns:

Read pointer of the TX FIFO.

uint8_t ppt_force_fw_ack(uint8_t entry)

Firmware force ack the first packet which may not be transmitted.

If the first packet in the TX FIFO is not transmitted, use ppt_trigger_fw_ack to ack the packet is not working. Instead, use ppt_force_fw_ack to force ack to discard the packet. PRX role may use this api to quit data pushed to the TX FIFO previously.

Parameters:

entry -- [in] Channel index.

Returns:

Read pointer of the TX FIFO.

void ppt_set_crc_param(ppt_crc_param_t *param)

Set CRC common parameters for all channels.

Note

CRC including address field is not supported. It can be as a workaround to replace the origin CRC init value by a new CRC init value which is calculated through the address address as the CRC input data using the origin CRC init. Only replace the CRC init value, but the CRC polynomial is not changed all the time.

Parameters:

param -- [in] CRC common parameters

void ppt_set_rx_addr(uint8_t entry, ppt_rx_addr_t *param)

Set rx access address of each channel.

The caller shall check whether any address value is 0xff or two rx addresses values are similar. The access address shall be chaotic as the definition in BT specification. If not, the radio parameter needs to be changed to receive the packets successfully. But this will decrease the rx sensitivity.

The radio parameter can be updated by ppt_check_rx_addr.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • param -- [in] Rx access address.

void ppt_check_rx_addr(uint8_t bit_th)

Check rx access address and set radio parameters.

If any address value is 0xff or two rx addresses values are similar, this function will set the radio parameters. Since the parameters are set according to the chosen rx PHY, this function shall be called after both the address and rx PHY are set.

Parameters:

bit_th -- [in] Bit difference threshold, recommended to use 5.

bool ppt_pop_rx_fifo(uint8_t entry, uint8_t *pdu, uint16_t pdu_len)

Pop the received PDU from the rx fifo.

The rx fifo contains the PDU data including the header fields and payload field.

The length of the PDU is the length of payload plus the length of header. The length of payload is attained at the rx stack information, refer to @PRO_LENGTH_TYPE. The length of header can be calculated by PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE or PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE_BYTE.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • pdu -- [in] Pointer of PDU.

  • pdu_len -- [in] Length of PDU.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- DMA error.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool ppt_pop_rx_fifo_with_wait_option(uint8_t entry, uint8_t *pdu, uint16_t pdu_len, bool wait)

Pop the received pdu from the rx fifo with wait option.

The rx fifo contains the PDU data including the header fields and payload field.

The length of the PDU is the length of payload plus the length of header. The length of payload is attained at the rx stack information, refer to @PRO_LENGTH_TYPE. The length of header can be calculated by PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE or PPT_RX_FIFO_HEADER_SIZE_BYTE.

When choosing to wait, this api equals ppt_pop_rx_fifo. When choosing to not wait, this api returns without waiting for the DMA move operation to be done. The user can use ppt_pop_rx_fifo_wait_done to check & wait for the DMA operation later.

Parameters:

  • entry -- [in] Channel index.

  • pdu -- [in] Pointer of PDU.

  • pdu_len -- [in] Length of PDU.

  • wait -- [in] Choose whether to wait for DMA move to be done.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- DMA error.

Returns:

Operation result.

bool ppt_pop_rx_fifo_wait_done(void)

Wait for pop the received pdu from the rx fifo operation to be done.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- DMA error.

Returns:

Operation result.
